suggestions.title: Tailor your IT résumé from the updated achievements sheet
suggestions.description: Your achievements stock and IT résumé were both updated and viewed yesterday. Turn them into a role-targeted Japanese résumé package without re-entering your recent accomplishments.
suggestions.prompt: Using my updated Google Drive files “IT職務経歴草案・実績ストック” and “職務経歴書_吉武亮人_ITエンジニア版”, create a tailored Japanese IT-engineer résumé package for my current job search. Keep the originals unchanged; produce a concise tailored 職務経歴書 draft, a skills summary, and a list of facts that need my confirmation.

suggestions.title: Create an MHI onboarding brief from your latest project materials
suggestions.description: You recently opened the Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Komaki progress sheet alongside the contract documents. Prepare a private, one-page onboarding brief that makes the first project conversations easier.
suggestions.prompt: Use my recent Google Drive files “三菱重工小牧プロジェクト進捗管理シート” and the related Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Komaki contract documents to prepare a private onboarding brief. Summarize confirmed assignment facts, project status, immediate questions to ask, and a first-week checklist; clearly separate facts from assumptions and do not modify the source files.
